Campbells Auctioneers are delighted to present this attractive parcel of land at Roshine, Burtonport, Co. Donegal to the open market.

Extending to approximately 0.37 acres, the property occupies a pleasant setting in this popular coastal area of West Donegal and offers excellent potential as a residential building site, subject to the necessary planning permission.

The site is conveniently located just a short distance from Burtonport Village, with local shops, services and amenities all within easy reach. 

Burtonport Harbour provides regular ferry connections to Arranmore Island, while the wider area is renowned for its rugged coastline, sandy beaches and scenic walks.

The nearby town of Dungloe is also within easy driving distance, providing a wider range of shops, schools, restaurants and everyday services.


For further information or to arrange a viewing of the lands, contact Campbells Auctioneers.

Our Ref: K1300
